title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 指向同一个变化：AI 的价值正在从模型能力，转移到把能力接进真实工作流的那一层。MCP、multi-model、概率型 judge 和企业里的 Salesforce 接入，看起来是不同产品，背后却都在回答同一个问题：怎样让 agent 真正进入工作，而不只是生成一段漂亮的文字。

archive.title: 工作流落地日报
archive.desc: AI 竞争从模型本身延伸到连接数据、重做流程、选择模型和把产品送进真实组织的能力。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-09-16 source feeds.

sections.title: From Models to Workflows / 从模型到工作流
sections.desc: 最值得留意的不是模型又聪明了一点，而是应用层开始承担把智能变成结果的脏活。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues that the biggest opportunity in applied AI sits in the chasm between model power and enterprise workflows. Someone still has to connect the right data, redesign processes, handle human-in-the-loop moments, run domain-specific evaluations, and manage security and governance. Better models do not remove this layer; they make more complex automation possible, which makes the layer more important.
original: There’s a massive chasm between the power of AI models and the ultimate workflows that enterprises are trying to automate. This gap is the opportunity for the applied AI layer to fill.

You need to connect the intelligence to workflows, often reengineer processes, aggregate the right context and data, allow for the right human in the loop experiences, drive change management, do domain specific evals, manage the security and governance of the data and process, and much more.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，应用型 AI 最大的机会就在模型能力和企业工作流之间的鸿沟里。连接数据、重做流程、安排 human-in-the-loop、做垂直评测，以及处理安全和治理，这些事情仍然需要有人完成。模型越强，能自动化的任务越复杂，这一层反而越重要。
original: 模型能力和企业最终想自动化的工作流之间存在巨大的鸿沟，这正是应用层 AI 要填补的机会。
你需要把智能接进工作流，重做流程，汇总正确的上下文和数据，设计合适的人机协作体验，推动变革管理，进行领域评测，并管理数据与流程的安全和治理。

rewrite: The takeaway: the AI economy will be built by companies that bridge intelligence into specific businesses, not only by the labs that train the models. Box CEO Aaron Levie says enterprises need software that understands their data, timing, approvals, legacy systems, and domain rules. His concise framing is that there is a lot of gap between the model and the workflow, and that gap creates room for a large application and diffusion economy.
original: There's a lot of gap between the model and the workflow, and as you bridge that gap over time, you get to a point where you realize, oh, I should also do the model.

The model could be the most intelligent, super intelligence in the world, but that workflow still requires you to connect up to other data systems, still requires these moments where there's a human in a loop interaction.

rewrite: 核心 takeaway：AI 经济不会只由训练模型的实验室建成，更会由那些把智能接进具体行业的公司建成。Box CEO Aaron Levie 说，企业需要的是理解自身数据、时机、审批、遗留系统和领域规则的软件。模型与工作流之间的空白，正是一个巨大的应用和扩散市场。
original: 模型和工作流之间存在很大的空白，随着你不断填补它，最终会发现：哦，我也应该做模型。
模型即使拥有世界级的超级智能，工作流仍然需要连接其他数据系统，也仍然需要有人参与其中。

sections.title: The Interface Layer / 接口层正在成形
sections.desc: 工具调用和模型选择正在从实现细节变成产品设计的一部分。

rewrite: Claude Code builder Thariq says MCPs are turning out to be better than CLIs for most integrations. As models improve at tool calling, tools can be deferred and MCP becomes stateless, making it easier to expose composable, parameterized access to data.
original: I was not expecting things to go this way, but I think MCPs are better than CLIs for most integrations. The models have gotten much better at tool calling, we can defer tools & MCP is now stateless.

rewrite: Claude Code builder Thariq 说，MCP 对大多数集成来说已经比 CLI 更合适。模型的 tool calling 变强后，工具可以延迟加载，MCP 也变得 stateless，数据访问因此更容易组合和参数化。
original: 我没想到事情会这样发展，但我认为对大多数集成来说，MCP 比 CLI 更好。模型的 tool calling 能力变强了，我们可以延迟工具，MCP 现在也是无状态的。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch makes the case for a multi-model future: hiding model choice from customers prevents them from benefiting from competition and from learning which tool fits which job. The model layer is becoming a choice users may reasonably want to see.
original: The future is multi-model. Trying to hide the choice confuses and hurts customers, who can't participate in the upside of the most exciting market competition of our times, nor master the best tool for the job.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为，未来一定是 multi-model。把模型选择藏起来，既让用户无法享受竞争带来的好处，也让他们学不会什么任务该用什么工具。模型层正在成为用户有理由要求看见的选择。
original: 未来是 multi-model。试图隐藏选择会让客户困惑并伤害客户，他们无法享受这个时代最令人兴奋的市场竞争红利，也无法掌握适合工作的最佳工具。

rewrite: Claude's Salesforce beta is a concrete example of the workflow layer: accounts, opportunities, and pipeline data come into the conversation, alongside 37 pre-built sales skills. Preparing a call, reviewing a deal, or sending a forecast becomes an action inside the same interface.
original: Salesforce in Claude is now available in beta. It brings your accounts, opportunities, and pipeline into Claude, with 37 pre-built sales skills.

rewrite: Claude 的 Salesforce beta 是工作流层的一个具体例子：账户、商机和 pipeline 数据被带进对话，同时提供 37 个预置 sales skills。准备电话、复盘交易或发送 forecast，都可以在同一个界面里完成。
original: Salesforce in Claude 现已开放 beta。它把你的账户、商机和 pipeline 带进 Claude，并提供 37 个预置销售技能。

sections.title: Small Models, Sharp Jobs / 小模型做窄任务
sections.desc: 当任务边界清楚时，最强模型未必是最好的产品答案。

rewrite: Every CEO's Dan Shipper says a new model they tested does not generate words; it generates probabilities. That makes it useful as a fast, cheap judge for tasks that would otherwise need a much larger model: in their testing, it was 25x faster and 600x cheaper. The opportunity is not always a better writer; sometimes it is a narrowly optimized evaluator.
original: it doesn't produce words as output, it produces probabilities. so it can efficiently act as a judge in cases where you'd need a Fable-level model—but in our testing was 25x faster and 600x lower priced

rewrite: Every CEO Dan Shipper 分享了他们正在测试的一种新模型：它不输出文字，而是输出概率。这让它可以作为快速、低成本的 judge，处理原本需要更大模型的任务；他们测试下来速度快 25 倍，价格低 600 倍。机会不一定是做更好的写作者，也可能是把评估这件事做得极其专门。
original: 它的输出不是文字，而是概率。因此，在原本需要 Fable 级模型的场景里，它可以高效地充当 judge，但我们的测试显示它快 25 倍，价格低 600 倍。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad questions whether a known output domain needs a general model at all. If the answer space is fixed, training a model to produce logprobs over enums may be a simpler and more efficient design.
original: This is cool, but if your output domain is known in advance, why not just train a model to produce logprobs over enums?

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 提了一个很实用的反问：如果输出空间事先已知，为什么还要用通用模型？对于固定答案集合，训练模型输出 enums 的 logprobs，可能才是更简单、更高效的设计。
original: 这很酷，但如果你的输出域事先已知，为什么不直接训练一个模型输出各个 enum 的 logprobs？

sections.title: Build for the Runway / 按生存路径建公司
sections.desc: AI 提高了执行杠杆，也让资本依赖和产品竞争的错误更快暴露。

rewrite: Investor and builder Nikunj Kothari warns founders not to assume the next round will arrive automatically. Capital is an accelerator, not the company's oxygen supply: first build a default path that survives without abundant funding, then model what extra capital would change over the next 6–18 months.
original: Capital is a weapon for acceleration. Used well you’re unbeatable. If you are so dependent on it, a simple downturn can lead to not so great consequences.
figure out the default path that ensures the survival of your company and a great self fulfilling business.

rewrite: 投资人兼 builder Nikunj Kothari 提醒创始人，不要默认下一轮融资一定会来。资本是加速器，不是公司的氧气瓶：先设计一条没有充沛资金也能活下来的默认路径，再推演未来 6 到 18 个月额外资本会改变什么。
original: 资本是用来加速的武器。用得好，你无人能敌；但如果公司过度依赖资本，一次普通的下行周期就可能带来糟糕后果。
找出一条能保证公司生存、并能成为优秀自循环生意的默认路径。

rewrite: Peter Yang's examples of bot work are a useful reality check: lead generation, competitor research, monitoring ad accounts, watching Jira, triaging support, testing hotel booking flows, and automating paperwork. The common thread is not a magical autonomous employee; it is a bounded workflow with a clear trigger, context, and handoff.
original: Find leads, draft outreach, and turn wins into case studies
Watch Jira, flag blockers, and draft the weekly status update
Triage support tickets, draft replies, and escalate with full context

rewrite: Peter Yang 列出的 bot 用例很能说明问题：找线索、做竞品研究、监控广告账户、盯 Jira、分流客服、测试酒店预订流程、自动化文书。共同点不是一个神奇的 autonomous employee，而是一个有明确触发条件、上下文和交接点的边界工作流。
original: 找线索、起草外联，并把胜利案例写成 case study
监控 Jira，标记阻塞项，并起草每周状态更新
分流客服工单、起草回复，并带着完整上下文升级处理
